_meta.status: Best-effort AI-assisted translation for the SIH26003 prototype — not yet reviewed by a native speaker or community linguist. Treat as a solid starting draft, not a certified translation; please correct before any real deployment in Mizoram.
_meta.script: Mizo is written in the Latin alphabet, as used here.
_meta.fallback: Any key missing here falls back to English automatically (see i18n/index.ts).

common.pendingSync: {{count}} sync ngai la a la awm
common.tryAgain: Beisei leh rawh, harsatna a awm lo
common.takeBreakBody: I inven rei tawh e. Rei tlem chhawlna in a ṭanpui thei.
common.clinicalNote: SmritiSetu chuan ngaihtuahna a ṭanpui a, hun kal zela danglamna chu hriat theih tur a siam. Hei hi zawlnei dan a ni lo. Damdawi enkawltu hmuh ula.

roles.choosePrompt: Tunah SmritiSetu tu nge a hman mek?

onboarding.welcome: SmritiSetu-ah kan lo lawm che u
onboarding.chooseLanguageBody: I awlsam ber ṭawng chu tep rawh.
onboarding.consentBody: SmritiSetu-in dam mi chungchang thil zawng zawng — a hming, game an tih te, leh a hmasawnna — hi device hi chauhah a khaikhawm. Sync tih tur i thlan loh chuan eng emaw hi device ata a chhuak lo vang.
onboarding.consentPointStorage: Data zawng zawng hi default-in hi device ah a awm a, internet awm lo pawhin.
onboarding.consentPointControl: Engtik pawhin Admin Panel atangin data export emaw permanent-a delete emaw i tih thei.
onboarding.consentPointNotDiagnosis: SmritiSetu chuan rilru lama tanpui tho tho a ni — sik dan enfiah a ni lo.
onboarding.setupCaregiverPin: Enkawltu tan number 4 PIN siam rawh
onboarding.setupCompleteBody: SmritiSetu hman ngai a la tawh, internet awm lo pawhin.

errorBoundary.title: Thil eng emaw a sual
errorBoundary.body: SmritiSetu-in buaina a nei. Data engmah a bo lo — i lo kir a, beisei leh theih a ni.

caregiverAuth.title: Enkawltu Login
caregiverAuth.wrongPin: He PIN hi a dik lo. Beisei leh rawh.
caregiverAuth.tooManyAttempts: Beisei tam lutuk. {{seconds}} chhung zawh chuan beisei leh rawh.
caregiverAuth.scanQr: A nih loh chuan i QR code scan rawh
caregiverAuth.forgotPinBody: He device-ah hian PIN recovery a awm lo, tichuan hei screen hawng theih tupawh hian PIN thar an siam ve thei ngei ang — hei hi damdawi enkawltu ho hian dam mite screen an luh loh nan lightweight gate a ni zawng zawng, security boundary tak tak a ni lo.
caregiverAuth.forgotPinMismatch: PIN a inmil lo — tih leh rawh.

adminAuth.title: Admin Login
adminAuth.wrongPin: He PIN hi a dik lo. Beisei leh rawh.

adminPanel.noPatients: He device-ah dam mi awm lo fo.
adminPanel.noCaregivers: He device-ah enkawltu awm lo fo.
adminPanel.resetAllDataBody: Hei hian he device-a data zawng kumkhua paih a ni ang. Zawh nan "{{word}}" ti ziak rawh.

levelSelect.title: Level Thlang
levelSelect.body: Engmah khaih a awm lo — level engpawh thlan la inven rawh. Nikhuaa inven tan SmritiSetu chuan level pakhat a lo ruat reng ang.

reminders.title: Vawiin
reminders.noneToday: Tunah thil ruahman a awm lo. Ka lawm e!
reminders.label: Hei hi eng tan nge ni?
reminders.scanFailed: Label chu chhiar theih lo. Photo fiah tak, eng tha taka lak rawh, a nih loh leh ziak ve rawh.

familyManager.title: Chhungkaw leh Hmel
familyManager.body: Naam Yaad tan mêl, hming leh aw ziak belh rawh.
familyManager.name: Hming
familyManager.noMembers: Tuna thleng mi belh a la awm lo.

dashboard.title: Enkawltu Dashboard
dashboard.gardenGrowthBody: Chawlhkar dang khatah ni 3 emaw a tam khel a khelin, hlingnu chu a khang zel — hun chhung theihtawpa hma sawn zelna en tur dan awlsam tak.
dashboard.domainBalanceBody: {{name}} chuan bial 5 zawng a inven dan inzeitihna
dashboard.cognitiveInsightsBody: Bial tinrenga statistical trend, he damlo taka session ata ata chhawn — biakna pahnih inzawm bawk lo, tute dang data nena inzawm lo tawh.
dashboard.shareWithFamilyBody: He link nei apiang chuan hetih chawlhkar hnathawh en tur an duh — login a ngai lo. A rawn thawn hnu chuan a update tawh lo; snapshot thar tur chuan link thar siam rawh.
dashboard.disclaimer: He dashboard hian damdawi enkawltu nena sawi tur ṭanchhanna a lantir. Zawlnei dan a ni lo.
dashboard.noData: Data a la rawn lo — inven ṭhenkhat tih hmasa rawh.
dashboard.reminderAlertsBody: Damdawi, tui, emaw thil tih hun a lo thleng chuan hi device hian vaubelh a pe ang che — SmritiSetu a hawn lai, background-ah pawh a lo work thei. Tab khar famkim tawh chu a kai thei lo.
dashboard.reminderAlertsOn: Hi device-ah hian vaubelh a hawn tawh
dashboard.reminderAlertsDenied: Phalna hi din a ni. Hei hi hawng nan i browser emaw device settings-ah hian hi site atan notification hawng rawh.
dashboard.reminderAlertsUnsupported: Hi browser hian a support lo.

asymmetryFlag.body: {{domain}} engagement has been notably lower than {{name}}'s other areas for {{weeks}} weeks. Patterns like this can be worth mentioning at their next doctor's visit.

sharedView.banner: Chhungkaw mi pakhat sharenna read-only snapshot i en mek. A update tawh lo, he device hi caregiver angin sign-in a ni lo.
sharedView.invalid: He link hi a bo emaw a danglam angin a lang. Link thar dil rawh.

smriti-cards.name: Smriti Cards
smriti-cards.instructions: Card inang inzawm tur inven rawh. Mêl eng nge a awm ni sut chu hre reng tum rawh.
smriti-cards.clinicalMapping: Card inang zawm chungin hriatrengna hnuhnung (MoCA) leh ṭawngkam hriatna (ADAS-Cog) nena inzawm.

smriti-katha.name: Smriti Katha
smriti-katha.instructions: Thawnthu tlem ngaithla la, mêl thlang chungin a chungchang zawhna awlsam chhang rawh.
smriti-katha.clinicalMapping: Nikhua thawnthu hmang chungin hun tawm hriatrengna leh ṭawngkam hriatna (MoCA, ADAS-Cog) nena inzawm.

naam-yaad.name: Naam Yaad
naam-yaad.instructions: I hriat mêl a lang ang. A hming dik tak thlan rawh.
naam-yaad.clinicalMapping: Damlo chhungkaw mêl dik hmang chungin hriatna leh hriatchhiahna (MoCA/ADAS-Cog) nena inzawm.

dhyan-dhaam.name: Dhyan Dhaam
dhyan-dhaam.instructions: Chunglam a lantir zir chi zawng inang tile apiang tep rawh.
dhyan-dhaam.clinicalMapping: Ngaihven zui reng leh hriatchhiahna hna (MoCA, ADAS-Cog) nena inzawm.

ginti-dhyan.name: Ginti Dhyan
ginti-dhyan.instructions: Number te chu tlem ber ata ṭan la, sumfai dan zelin tep rawh.
ginti-dhyan.clinicalMapping: Ngaihven leh hna thawk hriatrengna (MoCA digit span) nena inzawm, upa mi ang taka hmang tur.

awaaz-pehchan.name: Awaaz Pehchan
awaaz-pehchan.instructions: Ngun taka ngaithla rawh. Aw pawimawh chu i hriat chauhin button tep rawh.
awaaz-pehchan.clinicalMapping: Ngaihven zui reng (MoCA attention) nena inzawm, aw chauh chunga innghat, chhiar theih lo damlo ho tan.

dinacharya-sequence.name: Dinacharya Sequence
dinacharya-sequence.instructions: Mêl card te chu i nikhua tih dan zelin phun rawh.
dinacharya-sequence.clinicalMapping: Nikhua hna ruahman leh dan zel (IADL) nena inzawm.

bazaar-list.name: Bazaar List
bazaar-list.instructions: Bazar lehkhabu chu ngaithla la, tichuan a thil te chauh grid-ah zawng rawh.
bazaar-list.clinicalMapping: Nikhua hna lehkhabu hriatrengna leh IADL ruahman nena inzawm.

ghar-ka-kaam.name: Ghar ka Kaam
ghar-ka-kaam.instructions: In hmanrua pakhat tep la, tichuan a hman hna chu tep rawh.
ghar-ka-kaam.clinicalMapping: Nikhua thil-hman inzawmna nena inzawm, IADL enna a lo lang hmasa ber ṭheuh.

aakar-milan.name: Aakar Milan
aakar-milan.instructions: Zir chi dik taka tidip thei chhawn chu zawng rawh.
aakar-milan.clinicalMapping: Chhun-lam thiam leh hna thawk theihna (MoCA, ADAS-Cog) nena inzawm.

chaya-khoj.name: Chaya Khoj
chaya-khoj.instructions: Thil chu en la, a inang duihlim chu tep rawh.
chaya-khoj.clinicalMapping: Chhun-lam inzawmna (MoCA visuospatial) nena inzawm, chhiar a ngai lo.

naksha-jodo.name: Naksha Jodo
naksha-jodo.instructions: Chhawn lian te chu inzawm chungin mêl chu siam rawh. Hun la in ti hlek rawh.
naksha-jodo.clinicalMapping: Siamna leh gathon theihna (ADAS-Cog) nena inzawm.

aaj-ka-din.name: Aaj Ka Din
aaj-ka-din.instructions: Vawiin chungchang zawhna awlsam tam thleng chhang rawh.
aaj-ka-din.clinicalMapping: Hun leh hmun hriatna (MoCA orientation) nena inzawm. Hei hi nikhua enna a ni, harsatna zirna a ni lo.

ghadi-dekho.name: Dar En Rawh
ghadi-dekho.instructions: Dar chu en la, hun dik chu tep rawh.
ghadi-dekho.clinicalMapping: Hmuhruh leh hun hriatna nena inzawm (MoCA visuospatial/executive) - khawvel pumin dementia enfiahna atana hman Clock Drawing Test nen a inang.
